obfuscation_indicators: variety of estimates and numerous assumptions
risk_summary: The company has minimal operating activity, no current PegIntron royalties, and relies primarily on investment income and potential future acquisitions to realize approximately $101.4 million of NOLs. Repeated forward-looking disclaimers and contingent language emphasize substantial uncertainty around acquisitions, royalty payments, tax benefits, and projected income. Liquidity appears supported by rights-offering proceeds, but the business model and tax-asset realization remain highly dependent on uncertain future events.
